_scope_note: F2/F3 (evidence/audit2/Cascade.md:254-296): the final-sweep text must count as turn output, and the route budget must cover warmup/StartCascade/Send/retry/polling/detach instead of starting at the poll loop. Both defects were reproduced at 2598299e (streamed 'answer' -> 502 EMPTY_RESPONSE; 100 ms budget -> 310 ms behind a 250 ms Send) and re-pinned here against the fixed producer. Each mutation re-introduces one half of the fix; the two expectCaught:false entries are MEASURED survivors with the reason they cannot be seen from outside.
_baseline_provenance: MEASURED 2026-10-26 on the fix commit, Windows, Node v24.19.0, worktree w-FixF2F3. scripts/mutate-verify.mjs cannot run on this box (mutation-harness-utils.mjs requires git at a POSIX absolute path and throws at import, same limitation recorded in client-invariants.json), so the sweep used the harness's counting contract directly: exact anchor applied alone (must match exactly once), TAP structured counters, restore via `git checkout HEAD -- <file>`, clean tree + unchanged HEAD verified before and after. Baseline 18/18 green and identical in every mutated run. Results: mutations 1,3,5,6,7 CAUGHT (fail 1,1,3,1,1); mutations 2 and 4 SURVIVED by construction (see their names). Full log: evidence/final/FixF2F3.md.

mutations.name: F2: the idle_empty classifier arm ignores delivered output again — a turn whose text arrived in the final sweep is reported as an empty upstream failure (502 EMPTY_RESPONSE) after the bytes were streamed

SURVIVOR (equivalent while both sweep arms mark sawText): the terminal reason drops the `|| totalYielded > 0` half. No producer path can reach the clause any more, so only a future sweep arm that advances totalYielded without sawText would exercise it; the clause is kept as the audit-specified second layer behind the per-arm marking, and mutation 1 proves the classifier still refuses to turn delivered bytes into an empty failure
F2: the final sweep stops marking the turn as having text — a detached turn's snapshot freezes sawText=false, so the resume path resurrects the empty-turn verdict after delivering the answer

SURVIVOR (masked by the deadline-bounded reads): the poll window is granted the full route budget again. Every read in the loop is itself bounded by the remaining turn time, so a spent deadline ends the loop as max_wait whether or not the window agrees; the window line is kept because it stops the loop from issuing 1 ms-timeout RPCs after the deadline, and the difference is not deterministically observable from outside (it would depend on a 1 ms read timeout not firing). The detach-deadline assertion does catch the related regression through the admission pin
mutations.anchor: const maxWait = Math.max(0, turnStart + turnBudgetMs - startTime);

mutations.name: F3: a phase failure after the deadline is no longer converted to the route-budget stop — a Send/StartCascade that ran out of turn time surfaces as a transport error, which rotates accounts and retries a request that has no time left
F3: the Send RPC loses its remaining-time bound — a Send issued inside the budget can run to gRPC's 30 s default, so the turn returns after the deadline instead of stopping at it
F3: the shared workspace warmup is awaited without the deadline race — a warmup started by another request can hold a short route for the full multi-RPC handshake
